name: SiTime Corporation
moat_justification: SiTime is the dominant pure-play in MEMS precision timing (~90% of MEMS-based timers) with real design-in stickiness — a timing part is qualified per design and is a small but failure-critical BOM line — and demonstrated pricing power (Q2 2026 non-GAAP gross margin 67.1%). But the niche is narrow inside an ~$11B total timing market contested by diversified rivals and quartz incumbents, the top three distributors were 66% of revenue, MEMS wafer fabrication is sole-sourced from Bosch, revenue halved in the 2023 downturn, and current growth is concentrated in one AI datacenter capex cycle. A leadership position in a narrow, cyclical niche: moderate moat, not a wide one.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 3.3%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
one_liner: MEMS timing leader with a real niche moat (5/10) and explosive AI-datacenter revenue growth, but owner's earnings are negative on every base — normalized -$3.50/sh, latest FY -$2.74/sh, TTM -$1.08/sh — because SBC runs ahead of operating cash flow; no positive price clears the 15% hurdle until it prints a positive-OE year.
moat_for: Dominant share of MEMS timing (~90% of MEMS-based timers) — the pure-play precision-timing leader
Design-in stickiness: timing parts are qualified per design and are a small, failure-critical BOM line
Programmable MEMS platform (Titan/FujiMEMS) beats quartz on size, shock/vibration and temperature
Pricing power at scale: Q2 2026 non-GAAP gross margin 67.1% in AI datacenter timing
Renesas clocking acquisition (closed Jul 1, 2026) adds 550+ clock products and broadens the platform
moat_against: Narrow niche inside an ~$11B timing market contested by Microchip, TI, Infineon and quartz incumbents (Epson, TXC)
Customer concentration: top three distributors were 66% of revenue (Q1 2026 reporting)
Sole-source MEMS wafer fabrication from Bosch
Proven cyclicality: filed revenue fell from $283,605,000 (FY2022) to $143,993,000 (FY2023)
Growth now concentrated in AI datacenter (CED) demand — one capex cycle carries the story
